up: Return the exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested on human Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 1 (CHEMBL3650). Include the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID (or DOI if PubMed ID is missing), assay description, and target organism. Only return rows where the compound has a canonical SMILES present and the document has at least a PubMed ID or a DOI available. Exact IC50 values should be those where the standard_relation is '='. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3650'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
